policy: Independent content-first audit of all six project domains. This file is never exposed to the inspection agent and is not derived from a method output.

requirements.requirement: For a single left-hand lane closure on an undivided road, channelizing devices are placed along both the center line and the adjacent lane.
A non-mobile lane closure on a multi-lane road uses a transition area containing a merging taper.
A Lane Closed warning sign is used in advance of the closed through lane.
A ROAD WORK sign is located in advance of the work space on the affected road.
For this single left-lane closure, the W20-5 sign uses the LEFT LANE CLOSED legend.
In the depicted multi-sign approach, ROAD WORK AHEAD is the first warning sign encountered.

requirements.source_locator: Figure 6P-30, PDF page 959; Guidance basis SEC-6P.01 paragraph 02
requirements.requirement: The W4-2L Lane Ends sign is provided in the position and sequence depicted by the selected Typical Application.

requirements.source_locator: SEC-6H.02 paragraph 01 and Table 6B-1; PDF pages 838 and 813
requirements.requirement: The A, B, and C advance-warning sign positions follow the recommended spacing for the established roadway class.
Channelizing-device spacing does not exceed one times speed in taper channelization or two times speed in tangent channelization.
Channelizing devices that are no longer serviceable are replaced.
Channelizing devices are maintained clean, visible, and properly positioned.

requirements.source_locator: SEC-6B.08 paragraph 04 and Tables 6B-3/6B-4; PDF pages 815-816
requirements.requirement: The merging taper is at least L, with L calculated from speed and lateral offset using the applicable MUTCD taper formula.
The merging taper provides adequate warning and sufficient length for drivers to adjust speed and merge before its downstream end.
For a stationary lane closure, the deployed Arrow Board is located on the shoulder at the beginning of the merging taper.
Because an Arrow Board is deployed, it is used in combination with appropriate signs, channelizing devices, or other TTC devices.

excluded_invalid_activations.reason: The provision governs one-lane, two-way alternating traffic.
The provision restricts Arrow Board use; it does not require an arrow or chevron display in this scene.
The permanent lane-reduction and pavement-marking provision does not govern this temporary lane closure.
